Title: Effect of metformin on HbA1c in type 2 diabetes: a randomized controlled trial
Abstract: We randomized 240 patients with type 2 diabetes to metformin or placebo for 24 weeks. HbA1c decreased significantly in the metformin group (p<0.001). No serious adverse events were reported.
Inclusion criteria: RCT, type 2 diabetes, pharmacological intervention, HbA1c outcome

Title: Social media use and depression in adolescents: a cross-sectional study
Abstract: We surveyed 500 adolescents about social media use and depressive symptoms using the PHQ-9. Increased social media use correlated with higher PHQ-9 scores (r=0.32, p<0.001).
Inclusion criteria: RCT, type 2 diabetes, pharmacological intervention, HbA1c outcome

Title: Intensive insulin therapy versus conventional therapy in type 1 diabetes: 10-year follow-up of DCCT
Abstract: Long-term follow-up of the Diabetes Control and Complications Trial demonstrated sustained reduction in microvascular complications with intensive insulin therapy.
Inclusion criteria: RCT, diabetes (type 1 or 2), insulin therapy, microvascular outcomes

Title: Air pollution and respiratory outcomes in urban children: a cohort study
Abstract: A 5-year prospective cohort of 1200 children in urban environments found associations between PM2.5 exposure and reduced FEV1 growth.
Inclusion criteria: RCT, type 2 diabetes, pharmacological intervention, HbA1c outcome

Title: Empagliflozin and cardiovascular outcomes in type 2 diabetes
Abstract: In this RCT, 7020 patients with type 2 diabetes and high cardiovascular risk were randomized to empagliflozin or placebo. The primary endpoint was 3-point MACE. Empagliflozin significantly reduced cardiovascular death (HR 0.62, 95% CI 0.49-0.77).
Inclusion criteria: RCT, type 2 diabetes, pharmacological intervention, cardiovascular outcomes

Title: Mindfulness meditation for chronic pain: a qualitative study
Abstract: Thematic analysis of interviews with 20 chronic pain patients who completed an 8-week MBSR programme revealed four major themes around pain acceptance and coping.
Inclusion criteria: RCT, type 2 diabetes, pharmacological intervention, HbA1c outcome
